text:
Oh, absolutely. Why bother with the archaic, inefficient practice of actually brushing your teeth with a bristled stick and abrasive paste? That’s so last century. Clearly, the real secret to dental hygiene is to pick up a plastic dumbbell and give it a vigorous shake. It’s the ultimate multitasking hack: you’re not just cleaning your enamel; you’re simultaneously achieving that elusive "Greek statue" physique through the sheer kinetic energy of wrist flicks.

Who needs floss when you have momentum? Who needs fluoride when you have the illusion of effortlessness? The fitness industry has finally solved the human condition. We no longer need to sweat, we no longer need to scrub, and we certainly don’t need to understand basic anatomy. We just need to shake the plastic until our teeth are shiny and our delts are... well, hopefully shiny too. It’s not just a workout; it’s a lifestyle choice for those who believe that if it doesn’t look like a cartoon character invented it, it’s probably too much work.
